duplicated_clusters.name: Normative spec vs. code-verified drift audit
duplicated_clusters.note: All three cover the data model, envelope, fields, link rules, HTTP endpoints. SPEC.md is the canonical contract; INTEGRATOR-REFERENCE.md is the code-verified audit of those claims; DEVELOPER-REFERENCE.md is the schema-authoring companion. Overlap is by design but should be cross-referenced rather than restated.
